question: The Garia Carnival is conducted according to the guidance of which figure?
solution: The correct answer is __**Ochai**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Garia Carnival** is a traditional festival celebrated by the **Tripuri tribal communities** in the northeastern Indian state of **Tripura**. • The festival is deeply rooted in the **agricultural traditions** of the community and marks the onset of the **sowing season**. • The celebrations are conducted under the spiritual and ritualistic guidance of the **Ochai**, who is the **priest or spiritual leader** of the tribe. • The **Ochai** performs various rituals to **appease the deities** and seek blessings for a bountiful harvest, prosperity, and the well-being of the community. • The rituals include the offering of agricultural produce, singing, dancing, and playing traditional instruments like the **drum and flute**.
